description: Source code implementing UCI binding for switch configuration utility, including functions for mapping and applying settings from UCI configuration to switch devices.

methods.name: swlib_match_name
methods.description: Checks if the given name matches the device's name or alias.

methods.name: swlib_map_settings
methods.description: Maps UCI configuration options to switch device attributes based on section and type.

methods.name: swlib_apply_from_uci
methods.description: Main function to apply UCI configuration to a switch device, including handling global, port, and VLAN settings.
